raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Product Manager (Business Analysis)
UBS | India August 2023 – Present
• Managed end-to-end digital transformation projects in Compliance, Regulatory, and Risk Governance for
an Investment Bank, collaborating with cross-functional development and testing teams.
• Drove strategic business planning and roadmap reviews, aligning project deliverables with OKRs and

resolving incidents for legacy systems via SNOW and Atlas. Influenced stakeholders and understood business needs through effective communication and creation of business requirement documents.
Performed iteration planning, backlog prioritization, and collaborated with other PODs to deliver milestones.
Consultant (Business Analyst)
Capco (Wipro Company) | India March 2022 – June 2023

Led product lifecycle management from strategic planning to go-to-market strategy for a Capital Markets reference data transformation project. • Created EPICs and user stories in JIRA. • Facilitated Agile SDLC ceremonies including:
o Sprint Planning o Backlog Grooming o UAT Planning
Ensured successful project delivery while managing change requests.
Business Analyst
Finoux Solutions | India June 2021 – March 2022
Worked in Capital Markets domain on Angel Spark Android Mobile Trading Application. • Elicited and documented comprehensive business requirements for financial applications. • Produced: o FSD o FRD o BRD o AS-IS / TO-BE process flows
Managed product backlogs, story refinement, DoD validation, story prioritization, and stakeholder walkthroughs using Planning Poker/Scrum.
Associate Business Analyst
HCL Technologies | India May 2019 – June 2021
Banking domain – Cheque Transformation Project for Deutsche Bank client (US region). • Worked as BA to elicit and interpret client requirements. • Created process documentation in Confluence. • Worked on Change Management and MVP approach for complex requirements.
Associate
Sutherland Global Services | India August 2016 – September 2017
• Service Delivery • Teamwork
CRM • Customer Relationship Management • Customer Satisfaction
